definitions.gloss: transformation, transfiguration, dramatic change in appearance
definitions.explanation: A striking change in outward appearance or visible character. Often used for places, people, or things that have changed so dramatically they are almost unrecognizable. Emphasizes the visual or external aspect of change.

examples.japanese: ⟦{街|まち}→街：17306_machi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{変貌|へんぼう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{遂|と}げた→遂げる：14323_togeru⟧。
⟦{再開発|さいかいはつ}→再開発：17066_saikaihatsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧{変貌|へんぼう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The area in front of the station was dramatically transformed by redevelopment.

examples.japanese: ⟦かつて→かつて：10303_katsute⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧な{漁村|ぎょそん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{観光地|かんこうち}→観光地：14163_kankouchi⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧{変貌|へんぼう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{遂|と}げ→遂げる：14323_togeru⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{旅行者|りょこうしゃ}→旅行者：22927_ryokousha⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{賑|にぎ}わっている→賑わう：14235_nigiwau⟧。
examples.english: The once-quiet fishing village has transformed into a tourist destination and is now bustling with travelers.

notes:
USAGE:
{変貌|へんぼう} focuses on visible, outward change — how something looks or appears. It is commonly paired with ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{遂|と}げる→遂げる：14323_togeru⟧ (to accomplish/undergo) in the set phrase {変貌|へんぼう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{遂|と}げる→遂げる：14323_togeru⟧. Compared to ⟦{変容|へんよう}→変容：12115_henyou⟧ (qualitative, deep transformation) and ⟦{変化|へんか}→変化：03615_henka⟧ (general change), {変貌|へんぼう} emphasizes the dramatic visual difference.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {変貌|へんぼう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{遂|と}げる→遂げる：14323_togeru⟧: to undergo a transformation
- ⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧{変貌|へんぼう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be dramatically transformed
- ⟦{街|まち}→街：17306_machi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{変貌|へんぼう}: transformation of a town
- ⟦{著|いちじる}しい→著しい：10421_ichijirushii⟧{変貌|へんぼう}: remarkable transformation
